mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved monotonically from -18.0% (t-3w) to -10.9% (t-0w), indicating a sustained recovery trend. This directional momentum will persist over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further above its recent baseline mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 7.1 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the last 28 days (-13.4%).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated PARKS mobility (58.4% at t-0w) signals outdoor leisure substitution for indoor retail. If PARKS remains above 50% over the next two weeks, consumers will continue redirecting discretionary time away from retail venues, suppressing RETAIL_REC growth.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above 50% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 58.4% in t-0w, elevated for four consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points over the next 14 days while PARKS stays above 50%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility remains severely depressed (-26.7% at t-0w), constraining commuter access to retail-dense urban centers. Weak transit use will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery unless TRANSIT recovers by more than 10 percentage points within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is less than +10 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has been below -24% for all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points in week t+1 while TRANSIT remains below -20%.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility is consistently positive (4.0% to 8.0%), indicating essential-goods shopping remains stable. This stability in essential trips will anchor consumer confidence, enabling a shift of discretionary spending toward retail venues over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM positive in all four weeks, range 4.0–8.0%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0% in any of the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has declined sharply from -13.3% (t-3w) to -21.4% (t-1w), then recovered slightly to -17.6% (t-0w). If WORKPLACES continues recovering toward -10% or better over the next two weeks, office-based workers will resume weekday retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by more than 5 percentage points within two weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES recovered 3.8 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES declines further or stalls below -15% while RETAIL_REC fails to improve by more than 2 percentage points over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has stabilized near +3% (t-0w), indicating reduced lockdown intensity. Combined with PARKS elevation (58.4%), this signals a regime shift toward outdoor and dispersed activity. RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed as consumers avoid concentrated indoor retail spaces.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains between +2% and +6% AND PARKS remains above +50%
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stable at 2.7–5.4%, PARKS sustained above 36%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days while both RESIDENTIAL and PARKS remain in their observed ranges.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has surged to 58.4% (t-0w) from 36.1% (t-3w), indicating strong seasonal outdoor preference. This seasonal shift will persist over the next four weeks, maintaining consumer diversion from indoor retail and capping RETAIL_REC recovery.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above 50% for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS increased 22.3 percentage points over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 8 percentage points over the next 28 days while PARKS averages above 50%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT depression (-26.7%) combined with WORKPLACES weakness (-17.6%) creates a compounding suppression of commute-linked retail access. Recovery of RETAIL_REC requires simultaneous improvement in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES; if either remains below -20%, RETAIL_REC will stall.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -20% OR WORKPLACES remains below -15%
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -26.7%, WORKPLACES at -17.6% in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 4 percentage points over the next 14 days while at least one of TRANSIT or WORKPLACES remains in its suppressed state.
